notes.title: New small patch with few improvements and bug fixes
notes.notes:
Greetings, Cleaners!

We’ve been working lately on polishing up your cleaning experience, and we’re excited to share the latest improvements in this patch! Your feedback has been very valuable, and we’ve addressed several key issues to ensure a smoother and more enjoyable journey across all maps.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/6615b5661242b292c6e2a54a07419d754db93e73.png[/img]

[b]Localization Fixes:[/b]
Fixed mismatched fonts in some localizations for a consistent and polished in-game text experience.

[b]Completion Enhancements:[/b]
Improved the ability to achieve 100% completion on all maps—no more sneaky spots!

[b]UI Adjustments:[/b]
Fixed buttons being obscured during cutscenes, ensuring full accessibility.

[b]Map Improvements:[/b]
Fixed the bridge on the Forest map for better navigation.
Adjusted animal positions on the Forest map for a more natural and engaging environment.
Corrected the placement of misplaced trash piles across maps.

[b]Audio Upgrades:[/b]
Enhanced cat sound effects to make your furry companions more lifelike.

[b]Building Enhancements:[/b]
Improved the appearance of tents during structure building for a more satisfying visual experience.

[b]Material Fixes:[/b]
Fixed material issues in the Asian-themed scene for a more cohesive look.

[b]Scanner Update:[/b]
Fixed scanner functionality on the African map to help you clean up with precision.

[b]Plant Preservation:[/b]
Addressed disappearing plants to keep your green spaces thriving.

[b]Loading Bar Visibility:[/b]
Improved the visibility of loading bars for better progress tracking.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/d2feadb5dbad98c43071768aac2c154fc2a255cf.png[/img]

Thank you for your continued support and feedback—it’s what helps us make Fresh Start Cleaning Simulator even better!

Happy cleaning!
The Fresh Start Team 🌱

notes.title: New map, more activities, more cats (and more games)!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/daef43d0a4c4f4d83c7aa9b01de97a23231ee7bc.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone,

Today’s update is a BIG one for all you world cleaners and animal helpers! We’ve got a whole bunch of new content,[b] not only a new map that is completely free, but also some updates to the original maps in the game[/b] to keep you relaxed and interested.

This time, you’ll set forth on a journey to a completely new map - Africa - that will test your world cleaning skills! You’ll also meet some new animal friends - namely, the beautiful ostriches.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/0913bc4822093e2db5238c53e43371d08a56c7a4.jpg[/img]

[b]But before we jump into the details, we’d like to let you know that our newest game - Captain Pawsome - launches today in Early Access! [/b]

Captain Pawsome is a cozy 2D fishing game where you play as the titular captain. You’ll manage your own shop and upgrade your ship as you journey across the ocean, cleaning up the environment and catching tens of unique types of fish. If you’d like to set sail on a relaxing adventure with your own feline captain, be sure to check Captain Pawsome out!

[previewyoutube=LUlrsAthM7U;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1551000/Captain_Pawsome/

Now, let’s jump into the details of what’s new in Fresh Start with today’s update!

[h2]New map: Africa[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/a3298766fd2c0b1301b9e30d8648a988f35527bd.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/bb6e44333d1bdf26b4b3e23dbf82d4d5aafcc530.jpg[/img]

Those fires need to be put out and nature has to be restored to this beautiful piece of land! As you traverse the map, you'll stumble upon a quaint chapel atop a hill in need of restoration. Additionally, prepare to take on an entirely new challenge, as you help establish a coffee plantation! One of the other highlights of this map is your chance to encounter and assist the majestic ostriches in their natural habitat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/47f4ebd4b16fb0a120d4d33f045d4890c6baddeb.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/074e802df7d7a4fe21ed8122c5c9196a132969bb.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/08613a9314e62a2fe8d153bcf31fb23c76208e76.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/1b9c1e3068097b5a4b37059db352d78a7e2fc7e8.jpg[/img]

[h2]Old maps, new activities![/h2]

Each of the original maps now has 2 additional activities for you to complete. One is required for progress, the other one is not, but we’ve got a feeling that you’ll want to finish it anyway. The first one is cleaning muddied dirty posters that have been scattered around the maps. Give each of those a good ol’ splash and you should be done in no time at all. We've also scattered adorable new feline friends across these beloved maps and the second update is related to those fellas. Each of these furry friends has a knack for stylish headgear! While exploring, keep an eye out for a hat that you can place on your furry companions. It's a heartwarming experience that's not mandatory to complete the level but should add an extra layer of joy to your adventure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/e6f0d3b89df8ce8c96668c63949bcd7ab4ad10eb.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/b513dda6ea10f727882bf597bd77aa30d2234953.jpg[/img]

[h2]New map layout[/h2]
Finally, we’ve made slight changes to the overall layout of the world map to make it look better, while also trying to improve its readability.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/b3c237c5e82f2002ad1969534e346ffaf089717d.png[/img]

And that's all for today! We hope you enjoy cleaning up and bringing back nature and color to the 2 new areas. Thank you for continuing to keep the world clean and beautiful in Fresh Start!

Happy cleaning!

[b]As the Chicken Launcher team and Awaken Realms as a whole, we want to wish you a cheerful and joyful Christmas, and may this upcoming New Year be filled with amazing indie games that will enrich your libraries and bring you much joy—something we personally aim for as well!

Chicken Launcher Team[/b]

notes.title: Nominate Fresh Start in the Steam Awards 2023!
notes.notes:
Hey, cleaners!

The Steam Awards 2023 are kicking off today and it's the perfect time to celebrate the games that have made our gaming experiences unforgettable. [b]Today, we want to shine a spotlight on Fresh Start and ask you to nominate it in the Sit Back and Relax category.[/b]

Why do we think Fresh Start deserves to be nominated? It's a serene journey into a beautiful world of environments that need cleaning and animals in need of rescue. We believe that with its visually pleasing aesthetics, satisfying tasks, and the joy of returning the world to a refreshed state, Fresh Start offers a unique and relaxing experience. 

That's why we'd like to ask you to nominate the game in the Sit Back and Relax category. [b]If you appreciate Fresh Start's ability to help you unwind and relax, please consider clicking the banner at the top of the post to cast your vote.[/b]

The Steam Awards are all about celebrating the games that have made a mark on us, so go ahead, explore the nominations, and discover new gems that resonate with you. And if you think Fresh Start deserves your vote, we'll be over the moon with your nomination!

Have fun relaxing in Fresh Start!

notes.title: Stay on the map, put robots in the onsen and grab ALL the achievements!
notes.notes:
Hey cleaners,

Hope you're having a fresh day! The newest patch for Fresh Start is here, but first, let us express our deepest thanks to you, again. We're super happy about how the game's release went (aside from the bugs, of course - we hate them, too) and it brings us so much joy to know you've been enjoying the game. Thanks to you, we’re happy pandas! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/719fcb479787fb5719b82c0283c43b5ab485e3c8.jpg[/img]

We know that there have been some frustrating bugs and problems you've been encountering, so we set out to sort these out! You should now be able to get all the achievements while NOT falling out of the maps. Pretty cool! If you want to take a look at a detailed breakdown for this patch, here it is:

[b]- Steam achievements are fixed! [/b]
Now you should finally be able to complete your achievement stamp collection by befriending all animals.

[b]- Added an out of bounds failsafe mechanism[/b]
While it is unknown to us how to do it, some of you clever cleaners found a way to explore the endless underworld of the Fresh Start maps. Now, if that happens to you, you'll never again experience the endless fall - shortly after getting out of bounds you will be teleported back to the start of the map.

[b]- New feature - the "Back to Map" option[/b]
However if you can still manage to take the fall and are not taken back, or get stuck anywhere, you can use the new "Back to Map" option from the menu. Pressing the button will take you straight to the world map where you can restart the level you got stuck in (all experience points and junk will be saved for you).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/e3ed3de02c2046636de3c251fbec152818903908.png[/img]

[b]- Onsen & robots bug fixed [/b]
It is now possible to place robots in the onsen building.

[b]- Added the Control Guide feature[/b]
We've added a new section in the controls settings and now, you'll be able to easily access the controls guide (you can also quickly check it while you play by pressing the H button - this works outside of the tutorial)

We wanted to share something extra with you, as well. Turns out some Youtubers are enjoying Fresh Start as well, so we thought we'd point you to a couple of great gameplay videos from some amazing content creators. Sometimes it's good to put your own tools down and see someone else revive the world. Enjoy!

[previewyoutube=4nRa4njtypE;full][/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube=OPYO0pfSSPE;full][/previewyoutube]

Post-Apocalyptic Cleaning | Fresh Start Gameplay | First Look

Hopefully this little patch will make your Fresh Start experience even better. Please don't stop sharing your feedback with us, as it helps us make the game better. 

See you in the next one and take care,

The Chicken Launcher Team

notes.title: Fresh Start splashes out of early access! The full release is here!
notes.notes:
Hey, cleaners!

Today’s the day! The day we all grab our cleaning tools, suck the dirt up and sprinkle life back into the planet!

[b]Fresh Start’s full release is OUT NOW![/b]

The road to releasing the game was one filled with fun, joy and excitement. There were also challenges and hardships to overcome, but we managed, and in no small part thanks to your continuous support and feedback. The game’s better thanks to you, and for that we’re really grateful!

With the full release comes new content, and there’s lots of it! We teased it in the previous updates to keep you up to speed, but this is the time we’d like to show you (almost) everything that’s new in the game.

No more stalling - here’s what’s new in the full release of Fresh Start! Enjoy!

[b]Doubled content - 2x more maps![/b]
Not one, not two, but five! There are 5 brand new maps for you to discover, along with lots of new creatures to meet and help! That’s a lot of dirt-cleaning and water-spraying, but let’s be honest - that’s nothing you can’t deal with. Have fun cleaning them up and bringing them back to their clean and colorful selves!

Look at those sad faces - they need your help to be happy again.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/5f633b1b93bf810f67ccc35424bf184f39246501.jpg[/img]

Alps
A lovely mountainside is in need of some help. Bee there or be square!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/03b270b319732f38d8a04dbcfba5fd08d8d18f39.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/ae4175fd5b19891b02b825952b4704f73cc57d8a.png[/img]

Forest
Destroyed bird houses and wild animal feeders is something we can’t ignore. And the animal traps need to go, too.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/66f577b66896015f94b10dc9232f3f4a947265d1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/f7110649518efa4f8ae559122b9da63ee535bbb4.png[/img]

Onsen
Onsen are a place of rejuvenation. It needs some deep cleaning so that the inner and outer peace can be found and restored.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/a0361a306ad5983bfb6cfe146dc5943ea4b900d4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/58c567d4462f68ee159b5261b883b9495bb465a2.png[/img]

Garden
It’s not just a community garden, it’s a place that allows you to reconnect with nature.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/254dbfb9b4e445e84f77cea657afebf4d6b8dcc6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/f44716beaaac3a45f9a7f42bce2548e2aa94361c.png[/img]

Poland
This will be the end of your journey (unless you want to revisit previous maps) - clean up the countryside vacation spot and set up everything for a deserved rest. A surprise is waiting for you here - don’t miss it! :)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/e295601366a8aa5f561769a6e31685c838f03682.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/831f5cb6acb5e6395640520c2172fe09f4cf18a2.png[/img]

[b]Plenty of new quests[/b]
New maps mean new quests. As in the early access maps, these provide additional tasks you have to fulfill while cleaning up the environment. Each map has its own quests and each completed one nets you experience and brings you closer to fully reviving the nature. We don’t want to spoil too much here, though - we want you to find and experience the quests yourself. Happy questing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/309c12e6196bf6e8dfbb292c60bb5dc8603ff791.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/3598f2c161d648da7213cf4929d258f3c47f775c.jpg[/img]

[b]3 new skills[/b]
Someone watered the skill trees! Well, that’s convenient, isn’t it? Each skill tree now has its top skill available for you to unlock and use! With these, the fun of restoring the world will grow like the flowers you’ll be watering throughout your journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/7de3dee43dfe35ec52ec0fcecbadf05b9c36e065.png[/img]

[b]Water Flash[/b] - will give you power to destroy mud and water plants instantly
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/14d972ff7efc4e90fe3a41f6c8480d6f35932c0f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/4f99311df451ecf851da59d2535bcb2e160acafd.jpg[/img]

[b]Cyclone[/b] - turns trash collecting into a superpower
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/28763289ff3bedcf4ac542cd6c733af96318dbed.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/5c2e8970c8c8d0a6cc613fcfeb4547e5c3104b03.jpg[/img]

Robot Friend - forget about going back and looking for your robots - now, they’ll always be at your disposal

[b]New animals to save and befriend[/b]
Every map has new animals that need your attention… or at least a cuddle. Find them and help them out - they’re crucial to the well-being of the planet! They’re adorable, too, so be careful not to get swept away by their cuteness.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/a881baf2f013a53fc6327eb9cc0681413f77f681.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/c71c68c0edc2085ccead308c757ac41355f8213c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/b342691dff6c0348aee52485255923bd8563ee4d.png[/img]

[b]Upgraded UI[/b]
The UI is now upgraded and updated to be more readable, clear and overall better. You can check out the comparison below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/43f9bab1792e889ccbb5aa9e93928d9036f79fd0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/49d53bb65e99100f1105ff683516aa9d25123988.jpg[/img]

The way that quests show you what’s needed has changed too - now a bigger icon is shown on your screen instead of a small one in a white pop up above the interactive item.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/927d1d23de20cbfd980a2925a10efa6ec7171433.jpg[/img]

[b]Achievements[/b]
We’ve got something for the achievement hunters, too! If you’re one of those players that like some additional challenge in the games in the form of getting achievements, there are 24 of those waiting for you to grab. Also, additional 6 are hidden and you’ll have to find them by yourself. 



Full Controller support
The game now fully supports controllers, so you can grab the one that’s your favorite and play the way you prefer it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/0a73fb9894f50a748530838464c902e95b77ba5a.png[/img]

[b]9 languages to choose from[/b]
The game now supports new languages! Overall, there are now 9 language options to choose from. These are: English, Polish, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Japanese, Simplified Chinese & Traditional Chinese.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/9ee428dd0b6977aff2f835e25da3115ba03b1e6a.png[/img]

Whew, that’s it. We sincerely hope you’re satisfied with the amount of new stuff in the game and that you’ll have fun playing and discovering all the new content. We put our hearts into the game to make it a fun, relaxing and satisfying experience. If we managed to do that, please remember leaving a review helps us a lot and gives us an extra boost. 

Hopefully, this little world-cleaning journey around the globe will be something you enjoy. Maybe it will even put a smile on your face. If it does, that means we’ve achieved our goal :)

Have fun reviving the nature!
Chicken Launcher Team


As always, if you have any questions or concerns, please let us know. We’ll be more happy to help. Drop us an email at [url=contact.nplh@awakenrealms.com]contact.nplh@awakenrealms.com[/url], join our discord [url=https://discord.gg/ryJmMJqk]https://discord.gg/ryJmMJqk[/url], and of course you’re welcome to join the Discussions here on Steam: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1856030/discussions/ ]https://steamcommunity.com/app/1856030/discussions/ [/url]

notes.title: FULL RELEASE of Fresh Start will arrive on December 20th!
notes.notes:
Hey, cleaners!

We were very busy with working on adding more content and polishing the game and now… the Full Release is just around the corner!

We have carefully gathered your feedback to make the game better and we’re also super grateful for all the kind words from all of you. It’s truly heartwarming to know that the game can bring so much joy and tranquility at the same time, making it possible to unwind, relax and have some fun - it really feels like what we do matters and makes you feel better :)

Let’s jump right into the update proper. First, to have an idea of what’s coming, let’s take a look at the world map:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/7e5b73d884fbeaed9748099acc5032556c57424a.png[/img]

As you can probably tell by looking at the animal icons, we’ll be adding [b]FIVE BRAND NEW MAPS![/b] Each one is different, but all of them need your help cleaning them up and bringing them back to life - there’s mud and trash (and plants in dire need of watering) everywhere!

Here’s a little sneak peak of what you can expect (we don’t want to spoil all of the surprises):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/c191a37ec3459aba6112b5acfde095534fe32caf.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/67b09528cb2d43ca9c78920089153005a8d10329.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/b65f2a29199bacbf64adb80eae2e5626c24667ff.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/c5e97a7db5cce6dd41cf7b061b33040c2bf2a62b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/1bc067e24ca519067ea64bd0cf3a442ffa7a5b27.png[/img]

Apart from what we promised -[b] New Languages (including traditional Chinese), Full Controller Support[/b] and[b] Achievements[/b] - here’s what’s coming in the full release:
- New Skills (top of the tree skills)
- Steam Community Items
- Extra layer of polish to new and already existing maps (new map details, 2d art and more!)

We hope you’re as excited for the launch as we are. That’s it for today’s update, but there’s still a lot of places that we want to improve upon even more, so it’s back to work for us. Thank you for all your continued support and involvement!

Stay fresh!

The Chicken Launcher Team

notes.title: Whats next? Check out our plans for Fresh Start!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

Today we wanted to post our plans for upcoming features and improvements to the game but before we start we wanted to share the fantastic cake that we got for our small release celebration ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/accb7f175dd333c324a4b63b175af9e84fdd852c.jpg[/img]

Thank you so much for fantastic first days, such a great reviews and tons of valuable feedback!
We are now working on improving all necessary aspects of game and of course adding more content and maps!

[h2]What will come next?[/h2]
Here is a list of what we will be working on next:

[b]More Levels:[/b]
This is most popular request and we are now working on the next levels. 
You should get more details in next two weeks but here is a small spoiler ;)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/dcaf8c3185a7600700308f48244de3678f43d8d6.png[/img]

[b]No back tracking in Koala zone:[/b]
We will add more passages to Koala zone that you will be able to access once you progress so you can quickly move back to beginning of the level without backtracking.

[b]More spectacular Restore Nature (N) action:[/b]
We are discussing on how to improve Restore Nature feature to make it more fun and spectacular. We should have more details next update. 

[b]New game+/speed cleaning challanges:[/b]
Although there are no plans on new game+ we will add an option to play all levels how many times you like so for example you can come back to train station with all new upgrades. We are also considering adding timer and maybe online scoreboard so you can compete in who can clean out the maps faster ;)

[b]Achievements:[/b]
Yes we can confirm that Achievements will be added to full release version

[b]Full Controller Support:[/b]
We are now working on controller support and it should be available for full release as well.

[b]Language Editions:[/b]
We are also happy to confirm that there will be 7 language edition for the full access launch.
Polish
German
French
Italian
Spanish
Simplified Chinese
Japanese

[b]Lots of minor improvements:[/b]
We are also working on lots of minor improvements like better navigation on map, more clear quest descriptions, more clear nature restoration mechanic and many others.

This is of course not a finished list but this is what we will be working on in upcoming weeks ;)

Looking forward to your further feedback and thank you for playing our game!

notes.title: Early Access is live!
notes.notes:
Hey guys! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/e94999300d869c56ba2edb869316438c6b18bc82.png[/img]

Our game just launched in Early Access and we couldn't be more excited. Even though we worked very hard on delivering this version we are aware there is still a lot of work ahead of us - especially in terms of polish. You can be sure that we will be bringing soon a lot of improvements to the game!

For now please enjoy the 5 maps that we have prepared for this Early Access Edition and let us know what you think!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42654247/c583ad945733c60a2fa77c8b31810d00410dded5.png[/img]

We are looking forward to your thoughts and suggestions so we can learn what would you like us to do and where to put our main focus! Once we gather your feedback we will prepare a patch roadmap for following months and you can expect a new update with details by the end of this week! ;)

Meanwhile please use those links to send us any feedback that you have!

[b]Please report all bugs here:[/b]
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1856030/discussions/0/3388420865128635736/

[b]Please post all suggestions here:[/b]
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1856030/discussions/0/3388420865128883154/

[b]If you want to help us further please fill this questionnaire about the game: [/b]
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdsoP1ITIVQNaWxZbqGxrxmxh10tGDHAdI7BKpObk57gMNAug/viewform

Thank you so much for joining us and we hope you will have fun with our game!
See you soon!
